name: repo-hygiene
description: Audits Claude Code repositories. Two-phase workflow — Phase 1 sweeps 14 hygiene categories (permissions, hooks, CLAUDE.md bloat, Skills hygiene, process-abstraction, plus structural) and an optional 7-layer leak check. Phase 2 executes [APPROVED] markers from the report file. Use for repo cleanup, pre-distribution sanity, post-feature hygiene, environment audit, process-abstraction discovery. Trigger on "audit my CC repo," "sweep my repository for hygiene," "check this CC environment," "find process abstraction candidates," "review my CLAUDE.md," "clean up my .claude directory," "pre-distribution hygiene check," "find layer leaks in my CC setup." Routes structural findings to cc-design REMEDIATE. Composes with critic-gate. CC-only — does not scan Claude Projects. Do NOT use for building a Skill (use skill-builder), compiling a prompt (use prompt-compilation), scoring a single prompt (use prompt-validation), or auditing a Project (use project-audit).
